scope.description: Whole numpy application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: N-dimensional arrays, indexing/broadcasting, numerical ufuncs, linear algebra, FFT, statistics, random sampling and data interchange.

coverage.rationale: One PCA workflow covers a very small fraction of a general numerical array library; no breadth is inferred from matrix sizes or checks.

scope.description: Unit-aware principal components of correlated numeric measurement channels with variance/reconstruction requirements.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Channels, units, retention goals and reconstruction decisions replace eigensolver and subspace plumbing with analysis intent.

limitations: Bounded real numeric tables and PCA only; no missing values, general array programming, arbitrary linalg/FFT/statistical operations or causal interpretation.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
